† I. [נָדָה] vb.Pi. put away, exclude (NH Pi. (excommunicate) Hithp. Niph.; Assyrian nadû, throw, overthrow, destroy, etc., DlHWB 448 f.);—
Pi. Pt. הַמְֿנַדִּים לְיוֹם רַע Am 6:3 they that thrust off the evil day (i.e. refuse to think of it); lit. מְנַדֵּיכֶם Is 66:5 thrust away, exclude from association in worship (on usage v. Che).
